title: Calgary Street Art & Craft Beer 3 Hour Tasting Tour
includes: Easy and direct route to passionately researched art
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Calgary like never before on the Street Art & Craft Beer Tour, a perfect blend of culture, creativity, and community. Whether you're new to the city or a lifelong Calgarian, this tour offers a unique opportunity to connect with Calgary’s vibrant spirit while expanding your network and enjoying local flavors.

Explore the top-selected street art murals of the Beltline Urban Murals Project, created by renowned international and local artists over the past four years. Gain exclusive insights into the stories and inspiration behind these captivating works, directly from the artists themselves.

End the evening with a curated craft beer experience, celebrating Calgary's thriving brewing scene and fostering meaningful connections with fellow attendees. Join us for an engaging and organized evening that combines art, community, and the finest local brews. Perfect for professionals, newcomers, and art enthusiasts alike!
